units.source_text: > 东京下大雪了吧。

en.t: It must have snowed heavily in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 你家大门口那条具有王子风采的狼狗，拖着链条，冲着耙雪汉狺狺地狂吠，

en.t: At the gate of your house, that princely wolfdog dragged its chain and barked fiercely at the man shoveling snow,

units.source_text: 几乎要把绿色的狗窝拽倒。

en.t: almost pulling over the green doghouse.

units.source_text: 如果它也冲着我这样吠叫，我从远方来访时怎么也不能进门啊。

en.t: If it barked at me like that too, I would never be able to enter when I came visiting from far away.

units.source_text: 可怜啊，它终于把耙雪汉背上的婴儿弄哭了。

en.t: Poor thing, it finally made the baby on the snow shoveler's back start crying.

units.source_text: 你走出大门，和蔼可亲地哄了哄婴儿。

en.t: You came out through the gate and gently, kindly soothed the baby.

units.source_text: 这位老大爷衣衫褴褛，他的婴儿为什么竟是这样水灵灵的，这样可爱呢。

en.t: This old man was dressed in rags, so why was his baby so fresh and lovely?

units.source_text: 老大爷并不那么老，只是由于饱经风霜，显得苍老罢了。

en.t: The old man was not really so old; he only looked aged because he had weathered so much hardship.

units.source_text: 女佣最先去耙雪。

en.t: The maid was the first to go out and shovel snow.

units.source_text: 乞丐似的老大爷走了过来，点头哈腰地施了礼。

en.t: The beggar-like old man came over and bowed obsequiously.

units.source_text: 他说：这样老朽，步履蹒跚，背上还背着一个婴儿，

en.t: He said: Being this old and feeble, staggering on my feet, with a baby still on my back,

units.source_text: 就是耙雪这活计，哪儿也不会让我干。

en.t: even for work like shoveling snow, no one anywhere will let me do it.

units.source_text: 打今早还没让孩子吃过奶，可怜可怜我，请行行好吧。

en.t: Since this morning I have not been able to give the child any milk; please take pity on me and show me some kindness.

units.source_text: 女佣走进客厅，你正在开留声机欣赏肖邦的曲子。

en.t: When the maid went into the parlor, you were playing the gramophone and listening to Chopin.

units.source_text: 房间的墙壁是乳白色的，古贺春江的油画和广重的版画《木曾雪景》相对而挂。

en.t: The room's walls were milky white, and an oil painting by Koga Harue and Hiroshige's print Snow Scene at Kiso hung facing each other.

units.source_text: 壁毯是印度丝帛的极乐鸟图。

en.t: The wall hanging was Indian silk with a bird of paradise design.

units.source_text: 椅套是白色的，罩着绿色的皮草。

en.t: The chair covers were white, draped with green fur.

units.source_text: 煤气暖炉也是白色的，两头饰有袋鼠一类的装饰物。

en.t: The gas heater was white too, with ornaments like kangaroos at both ends.

units.source_text: 摊放在桌面上的照相册的一页，是邓肯表演古典希腊舞蹈的剧照。

en.t: One page of the photo album spread open on the table showed Duncan performing classical Greek dance.

units.source_text: 圣诞节的石竹花仍原封不动地放在犄角的百宝架上。

en.t: The Christmas carnations still sat untouched on the corner curio shelf.

units.source_text: 一定是美人送来的礼物，过了新年还舍不得扔掉吧。

en.t: They must have been a gift from some beauty, so precious that you could not throw them away even after New Year's.

units.source_text: 窗帘是……哟，我浮想联翩，仿佛看见了从未见过的你家的客厅……

en.t: The curtains were... ah, my imagination ran on and on, as though I could see the parlor of your house, which I had never seen before...
